disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry without a valid license is a Level 6 felony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is a Level 6 felony for a person to do any of the following: (1) Practice dentistry not being at the time a dentist duly licensed to practice as such in this state under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, hiring, or procuring an unlicensed person to practice dentistry is a Level 6 felony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employ, hire, or procure one who is not duly licensed as a dentist to practice dentistry

citations.kind: scope of practice / definition of practicing dentistry

definition_quote.value: A person is practicing dentistry within the meaning of this chapter if the person does any of the following: (1) Uses the word "dentist" or "dental surgeon", the letters "D.D.S." or "D.M.D.", or other letters or titles in connection with dentistry. (2) Directs and controls the treatment of patients within a place where dental services are performed. ... (4) Offers to evaluate, diagnose, prevent, or treat: (A) diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity and maxillofacial area; ... using nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures. (5) Extracts human teeth or corrects malpositions of the teeth or jaws. (6) Except as provided in IC 25-13-1-10.5 and IC 25-13-1-10.6, administers dental anesthetics. (7) Uses x-ray images for dental diagnostic purposes.
